description: The openapi-ts block: TypeScript SDKs that golem generates from OpenAPI documents.

sdks.description: The SDKs to generate, one job for each entry.

output.description: The folder that holds the SDK.

name.description: The name of the SDK client.

allowRemoteRefs.description: Load remote references from the hosts that remoteHosts lists. It needs remoteHosts.

remoteHosts.description: The hosts that a remote reference may load from.

maxRefBytes.description: The most bytes of one remote document. The default is 5 MiB.

maxRefDocuments.description: The most remote documents. The default is 256.

refTimeoutMs.description: The time limit for one remote document, in milliseconds. The default is 10000.

dates.description: The TypeScript type of a date-time field.

mode.description: standalone writes an SDK with no golem dependency. golem writes an SDK that uses the golem models.

extensions.description: The extensions that the block turns on. An entry turns an extension on; an empty entry takes its defaults.

mobx.description: MobX: observable SDK operations (mode golem) and observable validators of class models.
